India Approves First Dengue Vaccine for Public Use

The Indian government has approved the first dengue vaccine, QDENGA, for public use. The vaccine is approved for people aged 4-60 and offers a new prevention tool against the disease. The approval comes as dengue cases continue to be a public health challenge in India.
